name: DigiLocker
dev: National eGovernance Division, Government of India

android.desc:
DigiLocker is a key initiative under Digital India, the Government of India's flagship program aimed at transforming India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy. Targeted at the idea of paperless governance, DigiLocker is a platform for issuance and verification of documents & certificates in a digital way, thus eliminating the use of physical documents. The DigiLocker website can be accessed at https://digitallocker.gov.in/.  

You can now access your documents and certificates from your DigiLocker on your mobile devices.

quotes.text:
Interestingly, we have had these apps [0][1] for a few years now where you can store your IDs like driving licence, Adhaar, PAN card, voter's ID etc. Police and officials are instructed to treat these in the same way they would treat the original paper version of the document.

It's very convenient, I don't have to carry around anything except my phone.

[0] - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nic.mparivahan&hl=en&gl=US

[1] - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.digilocker.android
quotes.story_title: Germany to let citizens store ID cards on smartphone
